title: Shard Dominion
description: Full late-90s Westwood-style RTS: 13-mission two-act campaign with a real ending choice, 3 factions, tech tiers, stealth, artillery, garrisons, air power, Shardstorms, a living planet that hunts the greedy, superweapons, saves/replays, a mission editor, and 1v1/2v2 lockstep multiplayer.
